title: Jax

{{Infobox/Character |shop = Yes |location=[[Archery Range]] |location_page_description = Sells higher-tier [[Arrows]]. |x=-40.5 |y=69 |z=-92.5 }} '''Jax''' is an [[NPC]] located near the {{zone|Archery Range}} in the {{zone|Village}} who sells arrow-related items to the player. == Quest == After first talking to '''Jax''', the player can go in the room to his left and start a shooting quest. The player must remain on the elevated pressure plate the entire time whilst shooting at the {{Item|Redstone Lamp|link=}}s around the room.
After completing the first quest, the player will gain access to Jax's shop. After that, the time to complete a round of shooting all the targets gets shorter, but allows players to purchase better [[Arrows]] from Jax's shop.
After completing all 3 quests, Practice Mode will be unlocked, which tests how fast the [[player]] can shoot all targets. {| class="wikitable centertext" ! Quest
Number ! Time to
complete |- | 1 | 25 seconds |- | 2 | 15 seconds |- | 3 | 12 seconds |- | 4 |11 seconds |} If the player triggers the 4th round, by interacting with '''Jax''' with an [[Abiphone]] and shoots all targets under {{Green|11s}}, they can obtain '''Jax''''s Abiphone contact.
